title: Use of moved value
description: A non-Copy value was moved into another binding or function call and then used again. Rust records ownership transfers at compile time so the original binding cannot later access data it no longer owns.

title: Conflicting borrows
description: Rust refuses a mutable borrow while an immutable borrow of the same value remains active. This preserves the aliasing rule that mutable access must be exclusive.

title: Required trait bound is not satisfied
description: A generic operation requires a trait implementation that the supplied type does not provide. Trait bounds define the capabilities available to generic code.

title: Dictionary key was not found
description: A mapping lookup used a key that does not exist. Direct subscription communicates that absence is exceptional, so Python raises KeyError instead of silently manufacturing a value.

state_snapshot.event: Mapping subscription requested a missing key

title: Operation applied to an inappropriate type
description: Python raises TypeError when an operation receives a value of a type it cannot handle. Dynamic dispatch checks this at execution time rather than at compile time.

title: Incorrect indentation
description: Indentation is part of Python’s grammar. A block with inconsistent or missing indentation cannot be tokenized into the required suite structure.

title: Object reference does not point to an instance
description: Code attempted to access an instance member through a null reference. The runtime cannot dispatch an instance operation without an object target.

title: Cannot implicitly convert type
description: The compiler found an assignment between incompatible types without an implicit conversion. C# requires an explicit cast or conversion when data could be lost or the conversion is not defined.

title: Operation is invalid for current object state
description: A method was called when the receiving object is not in a state that permits it. The exception protects invariants that would otherwise produce an undefined or misleading result.
bad_example:
var queue = new Queue<int>();
var next = queue.Dequeue();

title: Cannot read properties of undefined
description: A property access was evaluated on undefined. JavaScript only discovers this when the expression executes, often after an asynchronous response or optional object branch omitted a value.

title: Type is not assignable to type
description: TypeScript determined that the source expression cannot fulfill the declared target type. The static check prevents a value whose shape or primitive kind is incompatible from crossing the contract boundary.

title: Null reference was dereferenced
description: The Java virtual machine cannot invoke an instance operation, access a field, or index an array through null. Modern JVMs can report the precise null-producing expression.
good_example:
String label = null;
System.out.println(label == null ? 0 : label.length());

title: Null pointer dereference
description: Dereferencing a null pointer violates the C++ abstract machine. It may appear to crash, appear to work, or be transformed unexpectedly by an optimizing compiler; it is not a recoverable language exception.

code: fatal error: all goroutines are asleep - deadlock!
title: All goroutines are blocked
description: The Go runtime found no runnable goroutine capable of making progress. This commonly happens when a receive has no matching sender or a lock cycle leaves every goroutine waiting.
